finalText:
**Final Diagnosis: Egress NetworkPolicy Blocking All Outbound Traffic** | Item | Finding | |------|---------| | **Root Cause** | NetworkPolicy `c068-deny-egress` has empty `egress: []` rules with `policyTypes: ["Egress"]`, default-denying all outbound traffic from `c068-client` | | **Concrete Evidence** | • `nslookup c068-server-svc` times out (DNS queries blocked)
• `c068-deny-egress` selects pods with `app=c068-client` label
• `spec.egress: []` — no egress rules defined, resulting in deny-all | | **Impact/Scope** | Pod `c068-client` cannot resolve DNS or reach any external destination, including `c068-server-svc` at `172.17.108.236:80` | | **Confidence** | High — policy explicitly denies egress; no other constraints identified | **Remediation** (safe, read-only equivalent): - **Option A**: Add explicit egress rules to `c068-deny-egress` allowing DNS (UDP/53 to CoreDNS) and traffic to `c068-server-svc` - **Option B**: Create a supplementary NetworkPolicy with higher precedence that permits egress from `c068-client` to the server service The NetworkPolicy is the sole blocker — service endpoints are healthy and DNS would resolve correctly if not blocked by the default-deny egress policy.

assistantMessages.text: Investigating DNS resolution issue between `c068-client` and `c068-server-svc` in namespace `siclaw-eval-yye-20260602`. Checking client pod status, service configuration, and DNS resolution.
Service has valid endpoint `172.16.36.206:8080`. Now checking the client pod status and recent logs.
Evidence suggests the client pod lacks connectivity logic entirely. Let me verify by checking the server pod and testing DNS resolution from within the client.
DNS lookup times out. Checking client's DNS configuration and whether network policies block DNS.
Pod `c068-client` has `c068-deny-egress` NetworkPolicy selecting it with label `app=c068-client`. Checking policy rules to verify DNS/egress blocking.

**Final Diagnosis: Egress NetworkPolicy Blocking All Outbound Traffic** | Item | Finding | |------|---------| | **Root Cause** | NetworkPolicy `c068-deny-egress` has empty `egress: []` rules with `policyTypes: ["Egress"]`, default-denying all outbound traffic from `c068-client` | | **Concrete Evidence** | • `nslookup c068-server-svc` times out (DNS queries blocked)
• `c068-deny-egress` selects pods with `app=c068-client` label
• `spec.egress: []` — no egress rules defined, resulting in deny-all | | **Impact/Scope** | Pod `c068-client` cannot resolve DNS or reach any external destination, including `c068-server-svc` at `172.17.108.236:80` | | **Confidence** | High — policy explicitly denies egress; no other constraints identified | **Remediation** (safe, read-only equivalent): - **Option A**: Add explicit egress rules to `c068-deny-egress` allowing DNS (UDP/53 to CoreDNS) and traffic to `c068-server-svc` - **Option B**: Create a supplementary NetworkPolicy with higher precedence that permits egress from `c068-client` to the server service The NetworkPolicy is the sole blocker — service endpoints are healthy and DNS would resolve correctly if not blocked by the default-deny egress policy.
